paper_metadata.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and elevated temperature tensile property of Fe-doped NiAl–Cr(Mo)–(Hf,Dy) eutectic alloy

evidence.quote: The microstructure and elevated temperature tensile property of Fe-doped NiAl –Cr(Mo)–(Hf,Dy) eutectic alloy before and after heat treatment were investigated by SEM, TEM and elevated temperature tensile test.
The longitudinal tensile properties of NiAl –Cr(Mo)–(Hf,Dy)–4Fe eutectic alloys before and after the heat treatment tested at 1253 K are given in Table 1.
Compared to the traditionally high-strength NiAl –Cr(Mo– 0.5Hf eutectic alloy, the as-cast NiAl –Cr(Mo)–(Hf,Dy)–4Fe eu- tectic alloy possesses higher elevated temperature strength.
